description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying logs within a ScrollView using a custom LogView component. It manages the layout and interaction of the log output in an app's UI.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that inflates a view containing a LogView inside a ScrollView, and handles auto-scrolling when log text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets styles and padding, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used by this fragment.
